metaTitle: How to Choose an RV Surge Protector or EMS
description: Choose an RV surge protector or EMS by amperage, protection type, voltage cutoffs and portable versus hardwired design, with picks by rig size.
directAnswer: Match 30 A or 50 A to your shore cord, then choose an EMS over a plain surge protector if your RV has an air conditioner or fridge. Look for a UL listing, low-voltage cutoff near 104 V and a reconnect delay of 90 seconds or more.
